svg.text: 9-Attribute Diversity Fingerprints, 24h Trace Recovery & Auto-Apply Gates
Mapping documented span keys, 15m buckets, truncation tags, and Cost-first estimate budgets onto incident blind spots & guardrails
Diversity Sampling: 9-Attribute Fingerprint & 15-Minute Quota
Server & Consumer Spans Only
1. service.name · k8s.cluster.name
2. k8s.namespace.name
3. db.system.name · db.collection.name
4. http.route · http.response.status_code
5. rpc.method · rpc.grpc.status_code
Omits tenant, model, or agent tool attrs
Client/internal spans do not split keys
15m Bucket Rules & Blind Spots
• Quota: >= 1 trace / key / 15m window
• 2nd..Nth hits rely on other policies
Blind Spot 1: No Tail Latency Shape
1 example cannot estimate p95/p99
Blind Spot 2: Shared-Key Masking
2 distinct bugs on same route + 500:
first hit fills quota; 2nd can drop
24h Dropped-Trace Recovery Ladder & Span Provenance
Step 1 (0-24h, Auto on All Tenants): Exact Trace-ID Lookup Only
Needs trace_id from logs, exemplars, or tickets; unqueried traces expire at 24h
Step 2 (1st Hit Writes to Tempo): Tags Applied to Every Span
• grafana.adaptivetraces.restored = true (separates restored vs. sampled)
• Large traces add truncated=true & truncated_percentage (doc ex: 93.93%)
Search Ceiling: TraceQL on restored traces is best-effort only
Heavy truncation on long multi-turn agent traces can drop late tool-error spans
Adaptive Metrics Auto-Apply: Gate Policies & Rule Precedence
unbounded (Coverage-first)
• Default if gate/policy is omitted
• Applies all recs incl. series-adding
• Restores detail for new queries
Prioritizes usage fit over series cap
no-increase (Cost-first)
• Applies series-reducing recs first
• Caps additions to same-cycle savings
• Over-budget adds stay pending in UI
Must be explicitly configured in API/TF
Caution: Cost-first uses last-cycle estimates—NOT live pre/post counts
Auto-Apply may alter exact-match rules (skips affix/drop) → set Exemptions first
Engineering Guardrails for Anomaly Detection & Agent Triage
1. Byte-based ~15s Volumetric sampling biases raw trace counts across services
2. Log sampler policy versions & timestamps so detectors ignore sampling shifts
3. Emit trace_id in logs & tool errors; test agent trace sizes vs. truncation
4. Exempt rare audit/SLO metrics before Auto-Apply; treat forthcoming Log Replay
separately from GA 24h ID lookup and online TraceQL-searchable retention
Evidence Boundary: "25% higher info density" & "cut volume by 90%" omit workload & metric specs—validate on local fault-replay suites
